card.name: The word views meaning opinions
card.fires_on: The word "views" meaning opinions or beliefs, usually after a possessive such as their, its, or his, or after "The" in disclaimers.

modes.label: Opinions held or voiced
modes.description: "views" after a possessive, describing what people think or express.
modes.example: recognize that it adopted its<< views>> for some of the same reasons two millennia

modes.label: Disclaimer wording
modes.description: "The views expressed here/in this article" at the start of a disclaimer.
